methodology_note: All URLs are public evidence. Third-party mirrors may be delayed or inaccurate. Posts quoted there are observations, not authenticated X audit logs. Distinguish account operators from legitimate historic account owners. Similarity does not prove joint ownership.
next_evidence_needed: Registrar RDAP and historic WHOIS records for landing domains
Passive DNS, TLS certificate history, and server responses for all domains
Authenticated X activity timestamps and security notices from affected account owners
Beneficiary/affiliate contracts or verifiable payment records
WhatsApp group administrator or official compliance details if voluntarily and lawfully disclosed

notes.coverage: Public promotional posts, mirrors, live landing pages, publicly revealed redirects; no authenticated X control logs or historical RDAP/DNS records.
notes.attribution: Graph connectivity supports shared campaigns and possible common software, not common beneficial ownership or fraudulent intent.
notes.specific_gap: No verified link from the earlier domain family (MarketOpenList/SessionLevels) to StockSelectAI/SpinOfDesk operators; same general tactics not sufficient.

publication_notes.status: alleged patterns and observed public links, not identity or company attribution
publication_notes.limitations: Third-party X mirrors and URL date strings may be incomplete; no common corporate owner, account controller, referral payments, or criminal conduct established for named handles.
publication_notes.classification: review-required observations; some source claims may not have been reverified in the current turn
